<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M+1 (~20 % of base peak) and M+2 (~2 %) matching the expected distribution from many 13C atoms, with no characteristic large M+2 or M+4 peaks that would indicate Cl, Br, or S—the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
